title: The Final Alibi Anew
author: Silas Nystrom
blurb: Sebastian Vasquez, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
